terms.gloss: hang by a thread: be in great danger
terms.grammar: pendeō, pendēre, pependī with the ablative fīlō
evidence: Ov. P. 4.3.35: omnia sunt hominum tenuī pendentia fīlō (Lewis & Short s.v. pendeō)
Enn. Ann. 153 Vahlen: hāc noctū fīlō pendēbit Etrūria tōta (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: A proverb in Latin as in English; tenuī fīlō pendēre is the fuller form.

phrases.latin: omnia sunt hominum tenuī pendentia fīlō
phrases.english: all human things hang by a slender thread

sources: Lewis & Short: filum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 393.
